item.title: Two-alarm fire forces evacuation of Newport’s historic Castle Hill Inn
item.description: NEWPORT – A two-alarm fire broke out at the Castle Hill Inn Thursday night, prompting the evacuation of guests and staff and drawing a large emergency response. item.title: Freetown company pleads guilty to OSHA violations after worker’s death
item.description: FREETOWN – A Middleboro Road company faces more than $200,000 in fines for violating safety protocols after an incident that resulted in a worker’s death three years ago, WPRI-TV CBS 12 reported. item.title: House panel advances bill to facilitate sale of Roger Williams, Fatima hospitals
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The House Committee on Finance advanced legislation on Friday that could facilitate the sale of Roger Williams Medical Center and Our Lady of Fatima Hospital. item.title: R.I. enacts transaction reporting requirements for health care groups
item.description: PROVIDENCE – Under legislation that took effect in late January, Rhode Island medical practice groups must now provide the R.I. Attorney General’s Office with advance notice of planned mergers, consolidations and acquisitions. Previously, health practice groups did not have to provide notice of non-hospital transactions, Attorney General Peter F. Neronha’s office said in an explanatory statement. item.title: Brown University Health researchers identify new target for glioblastoma treatment
